_how: Edit after each run: name/date/commit, the results.json files of the full run (first) and of performance, cross-browser and live, the performance results file used for the speed table, one entry in failures for each unexpected failure of the full run (test, device, cause, verdict, after_recheck; the report build stops until every failure is traced), any targeted re-runs (their results replace "Latest"), and append a row to history: [run, date, scope, passed, expected_fail, failed, flaky, duration, what happened]. Paths are relative to the repository root.
name: Run 13
label: Run 13 is the full regression on the final suite (2026-11-09, 2 workers, 37 minutes): chromium, phone, tablet, ipad and offline, 857 tests, no unexpected failure and nothing flaky. It followed a review of the whole app for screens no test reached, which added REG-941 to REG-945 (recordings on their way in a live share, the crash screen, a class shared live straight after it is made) and found app defects DEF-514 and DEF-515. The first full run that day (856 tests, before REG-945) also had no unexpected failure. Performance and cross-browser come from the same day (8 / 8, 16 / 16). The real-server results come from Run 13 live (31 tests, one at a time), whose 6 failures were each traced (see Run History): 3 tests gave up after 30 s on the server's list of live shares, which took 42 s (new server defect DEF-516, now tested by REG-946); 2 shared to a class seconds after making it and hit DEF-515; 1 lost its PIN input in MoBrowser. After the fixes they passed on re-check, and REG-946 reproduced DEF-516.
